decisions.title: Name, license, repo
decisions.decision: agentbelt, Apache-2.0, fresh public-ready repo with no private history

decisions.title: MCP SDK
decisions.why: verified stable on npm; negotiates protocol versions back to 2024-10-07

decisions.title: Untrusted plugins fail closed
decisions.decision: third-party plugins install with --ignore-scripts and run only in an OS sandbox; refused if none is available
decisions.why: a permission manifest is not a sandbox

decisions.title: Model-independent, local-first routing
decisions.decision: tools need no LLM; routing prefers local models with checked capabilities; complex/high-risk work goes to a user-selected model; never silent cloud

decisions.title: Project state
decisions.decision: single JSON source (.agentbelt/project.json) with lock + atomic writes + backup; Markdown views generated; MASTER_PLAN.md human-owned
